title: Just Optimised
description: Speeds up the game performance by a lot for both client and server
body:
**If you want a modpack that speeds up the game performance for both client and server this modpack is for you**


**If you play on 26.1.2 read ts, if u play on 26.2+ you don't have to**

- It basically upgrades the game math and makes it more efficient.

- If you think the game looks a bit pixelated and you don't like it you can disable Super Resolution (you shouldn't feel a very big fps drop).

- If you see any type of laggy GUI disable Exordium if you want _(the mod limits the GUI and screens at a lower framerate to speed up the worldrendering)_

- If you have any problems with the create mod farms disable immersive optimization


**For more details related to a specific modpack problem solving check the changelog**

**I've got 493 fps at 32 chunks** (Intel Core i5-12400F + NVIDIA RTX 3060)

![32 chunks view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6117ba06d06d8f7ca7761566e494626e4ee2017.png)
